laws.name: California Paid Sick Leave Law
laws.description: Requires employers to provide paid sick leave to all employees. Employees accrue at least 1 day per month or 5 days per year.

duration.notes: Minimum per year or 1 day per month accrual

other_requirements: Covers employee's own health condition or that of family member

laws.notes: Can be used for preventive care, diagnosis, or treatment. Employees can use up to 40 hours or 5 days per year, whichever is greater.

laws.name: California Family Rights Act
laws.description: Provides up to 12 weeks of unpaid, job-protected leave per year for specified family and medical reasons.

other_requirements: Worked at least 1,250 hours in past 12 months
Worked at least 1,250 hours in past 12 months

laws.notes: Can be combined with FMLA. Covers birth, adoption, foster care, employee's serious health condition, and family member's serious health condition.

laws.name: California Domestic Violence, Sexual Assault, and Stalking Leave
laws.description: Employees who are victims of domestic violence, sexual assault, or stalking may take time off to seek legal assistance, medical care, or safety planning.

duration.notes: Reasonable time; specific duration varies by circumstance

other_requirements: Victim of domestic violence, sexual assault, or stalking

leave_types.notice_requirement: Whenever practicable, reasonable notice to employer

laws.notes: Employer cannot retaliate. Time off for obtaining restraining order, seeking medical attention, counseling, or safety planning.

laws.name: California Jury Duty Leave
laws.description: Employers cannot penalize employees for jury service or court-ordered appearance.

other_requirements: Summoned for jury service or court appearance

laws.notes: Employer cannot discriminate, threaten, coerce, or discharge employee for jury service.

laws.name: California Voting Leave
laws.description: Employees may take up to 2 hours off work to vote in any statewide or federal election without loss of pay.

other_requirements: Insufficient time outside work hours to vote

leave_types.notice_requirement: Notice to employer before election day when practicable

laws.notes: Time off must be taken at the beginning or end of work day at employer's discretion.
